about.metaDescription: MalluMarktplatz connects Malayali-owned businesses with the community across Germany.
about.title: About MalluMarktplatz
about.intro: MalluMarktplatz is the home of Malayali businesses and professionals in Germany. "Mallu" stands for the Malayali community, "Marktplatz" is German for marketplace.
about.mission: We want every Malayali in Germany – whether they arrived last week or decades ago – to easily find trusted businesses, professionals and services from within the community, and we want to help Malayali entrepreneurs grow.
about.how1: Business owners submit their listing for free.
about.how2: Our team reviews every submission before it is published.
about.how3: Visitors search by name, category, city or postal code and contact businesses directly.
about.verified: A verified badge is only shown after our team has actually checked a business's details. Listings without the badge are reviewed for quality but not independently vetted.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions, feedback or partnership ideas? We'd love to hear from you.
contact.listingIssues: To report a problem with a specific listing or request its removal, please use the "Report this listing" button on the business page.
